Use of these pages

This legal center groups the public information a player may need before, during, or after using Brikaya. The privacy policy explains local game data and choices. The terms describe fair use and availability. Data deletion gives self-service steps, while cookies and support explain browser storage, contact, and practical help. Each subject has a stable address that can be opened without an account.

Read the page that matches your question rather than treating every notice as the same document. Material changes to accounts, payments, advertising, personal data, or access rules must be reflected in the relevant page before the feature is offered. The update date on each notice helps players identify the current version. Older or overlapping notices may remain accessible for reference but are not presented as separate promises.
